title: catha venenata
intro: Catha venenata, commonly known as Somaliland khat, is a plant species in the family Celastraceae. It is a shrub native to the Horn of Africa and parts of the Arabian Peninsula. The health benefits of Catha venenata include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve appetite, and aid in digestion. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as cathinone, cathine, and norephedrine, which exhibit therapeutic actions including stimulating the central nervous system, increasing alertness, and providing a mild analgesic effect.
